text: Where were you between eight and ten on Friday night?
I was at the diner on Fifth the whole time. I got there at eight.
Just me. I sat at the counter.
You mentioned earlier you met a friend.
Right—yeah, Sam came later. Maybe around nine.
Not long. We talked and I left.
What time did you leave the diner?
I was gone by eight-thirty. Traffic was bad getting home.
I might have the times mixed up. It was a long day.
Where did you go after the diner?
Straight home. I already said that.
Earlier you said you were at the diner the whole time until ten.
I meant I was out until ten. Part of it was the diner.
